readings.consumed_scope: Native PDF pages 1-3, Section 1, Theorem 1.1 and Lemma 1.2: elementary cutoff construction of arbitrary smooth jets. G.1 supplies the full derivative bounds, uniform convergence and differentiation proof; G.2 proves the even-function and smooth half-line extension consequences internally.

source_corrections.title: A Characterization of Invariant Connections

correction.source_locator: Lemma 4.7(3), native TeX lines 877-878, native PDF page 10; used in Proposition 4.8 on page 11
correction.proof: Set q=e, beta=alpha and the source patch tangent to zero in compatibility (E.9). Every vector killed by D then has lambda=0. Two preimages differ by ker(D), proving factorization directly.

source_corrections.scope_limit: The relevant native mathematical text through Appendix B has been read. All used assertions have complete internal proofs; no onward cited source was read or used. G.1-G.2 replace the externally cited even-function/extension results. Bibliography and contextual conclusions are not proof providers.
source_corrections.redistribution: Source files remain private evidence. Newly written lesson proofs and exact source attribution are delivered.

additional_corrections.source_locator: Case 5.2, equation (5.1), native PDF page 15; native TeX label eq:consistgauge
additional_corrections.issue: For s_beta=(k s_alpha) delta, the printed adjoint uses delta, whereas the change-of-section formula requires delta inverse.
additional_corrections.lesson_proof: F.2, equation (F.6), directly from Conn A.3; necessity and sufficiency both proved.

additional_corrections.issue: The punctured dilation formula must include the principal Ad(g inverse) factor and the inverse radius in the angular derivative; the radial argument must be a scalar.
additional_corrections.lesson_proof: F.8, equation (F.14), derived by differentiating polar coordinates and then applying Conn A.3.
